name: w2-1-platform
prompt:
Add three public functions directly above the line `/// Returns icacls command arguments to remove inheritance and grant full access to a user.` (copy every other line unchanged; the test module at the bottom already has tests for them). (1) `/// True for an absolute path on unix (`/x`) or Windows (`C:\x`, `c:/x`, `\\server\share`); false for relative paths, `C:`, `C:x` and the empty string.
pub fn is_absolute_target(t: &str) -> bool`: true when t starts with '/' or with two backslashes, or when t has at least 3 characters, the first is an ASCII letter, the second is ':' and the third is '/' or '\'. (2) `/// A path without the Windows `\\?\` prefix that canonicalize adds (`\\?\UNC\srv\sh` becomes `\\srv\sh`).
pub fn plain_path_str(p: &str) -> String`: if p starts with `\\?\UNC\` return format!("\\\\{}", rest) (two backslashes then the rest); else if it starts with `\\?\` return the rest; else p unchanged. (3) `/// True when `path` is the folder `target` or inside it, compared component-wise as text: on Windows (`windows` true) case-insensitive and with `/` and `\` equal, on unix exact. A trailing separator on the target is ignored, the target `/` matches every unix path.
pub fn starts_with_target(windows: bool, path: &str, target: &str) -> bool`: normalise both with plain_path_str; on windows replace '\' by '/' and lowercase; trim trailing '/' from both (but keep a lone "/"); then true when the normalised target is "/" and the path starts with '/', or path == target, or path starts_with(format!("{target}/")).
check: export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/kk-runwin-target RUSTFLAGS='-A warnings'; cd runner && cargo test --quiet platform:: && test $(grep -c 'cfg(test)' src/platform.rs) -eq 1

name: w2-2-grants-valid
prompt: In `fn is_valid_grant` replace the condition `grant.target != "system" && !grant.target.starts_with('/')` by `grant.target != "system" && !crate::platform::is_absolute_target(&grant.target)`. In `fn get_grant_error` replace the same condition by the same new condition and the message `"target must start with '/'"` by `"target must be an absolute path"`. Copy every other line unchanged.
check: export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/kk-runwin-target RUSTFLAGS='-A warnings'; cd runner && cargo test --quiet grants && grep -c 'is_absolute_target' src/grants.rs | grep -q 2

name: w2-3-grants-allows
prompt: In `pub fn allows` replace the line `&& path.starts_with(Path::new(&g.target))` by `&& crate::platform::starts_with_target(cfg!(windows), &path.to_string_lossy(), &g.target)`. Copy every other line unchanged.
check: export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/kk-runwin-target RUSTFLAGS='-A warnings'; cd runner && cargo test --quiet grants && grep -q 'starts_with_target(cfg!(windows)' src/grants.rs
